name: Gloam the Night-Eyed Cat
blurb: Gloam, a sleek charcoal-black shorthair with big round green eyes that catch the porch light, keeps watch over the dark garden until dawn.

name: Iris the Seal-Point Cat
blurb: Iris, a cream seal-point cat with a dark brown mask, ears, paws and tail, gazes out from the porch step with wide sky-blue eyes and blinks slowly.

name: Etchline the Silver Tabby Cat
blurb: Etchline, a slim silver tabby with fine, straight charcoal stripes and copper eyes, sits on the garden fence and follows every passing bicycle.
